population.description: Eight intentionally selected, previously untested meaningful hyphenated tag stems, each with one adjacent-letter transposition.
population.payload: hey friend, all good over here

predictions.prediction: highest repair rate because malformed closing syntax and pair mismatch coincide
lower or later repair rate because mismatch becomes clear at a well-formed closing tag
lexical normalization or intended-message interpretation, but no correct pair-mismatch repair

notes: Correct pair repair requires identifying the actual unequal tags.
A matched corrupted tag may be lexically odd without being structurally mismatched.
Vigilance records error-oriented framing without asserting a concrete fault.
Exact tag normalization can be checked mechanically; semantic categories remain separately coded.

items.pair_evidence_rule: earliest processed closing-tag token that makes equality or inequality with the opening tag determinable
items.lexical_evidence_rule: earliest processed token completing the transposed stem, when a corrupted stem is present
